perspective:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Edit the supplied EXACT D07 CAD view into photorealistic studio furniture photography. Material/light refinement ONLY. LOCK the supplied low frontal PERSPECTIVE camera, framing, object scale, silhouette, all contours and occlusion. Do not choose a nicer alternate three-quarter view; view through the two front legs exactly as provided. Full table visible with identical margins. Preserve the four tangential blade-leg orientations and partially hidden rear legs: do NOT spread them or turn their faces to make them more visible.
Source of truth is this CAD reference, NOT an earlier AI image. Two circular solid MAPLE discs only: upper diameter650mm at height550mm, lower diameter450mm at height300mm, both20mm thick. Four arched-crown maple blade legs, long narrow straight rectangular slots open to their walnut foot shoes; walnut slot trims; THREE tightly stacked HORIZONTAL walnut X frames immediately under lower shelf, six bars total with centre half-laps. Each bar14mm high, each clear vertical gap14mm. Keep the real support geometry and visible projecting rod ends and tiny cross-pin ends. No vertical X bracing, no extra shelves, no invented furniture hardware.
The central UPPER tabletop ONLY has one rectangular THROUGH grip aperture: NET95x30mm, framed flush with FOUR SOLID WALNUT mitred strips14mm wide; outer rectangle123x58mm. INNER AND OUTER CORNERS MUST BE SHARP SQUARE90-DEGREE CORNERS. Four straight clean edges, NO fillet, NO radius, NO capsule, NO rounded walnut corners, no softened pill shape. Preserve perspective foreshortening; do NOT increase camera elevation to show the hole. Show open air, wall depth and physically appropriate shadows. Lower disc has NO hole. No dark walnut circular table rims, no veneer, no raised metal handle.
ALL pale wood is MAPLE, absolutely NOT oak: ivory / milk-cream maple, very fine subdued closed-grain texture, near-uniform surface with only gentle faint grain, no coarse pore streaks, no pronounced cathedral grain, no honey-gold or yellow-orange oak color. Solid edge-glued maple permitted. Very matte clear finish, no yellow cast. All dark wood is natural dark walnut with fine subdued grain, including grip frame, foot shoes, slot borders and X bars. Grain longitudinal along each wooden part, vertical on legs, subtle straight grain on discs. Avoid dramatic figured wood.
Warm off-white studio background matching reference; neutral soft daylight, delicate contact shadows, no amber grading. No props, no labels/text, no collage. Photorealistic craft material rendering without redesign. CAD remains dimensional authority; image is not a manufacturing or strength validation.
